cards.back: One of the symbols 0 to 9. The number 47 has two digits, 4 and 7.
cards.say: Digit. One of the symbols zero to nine. The number forty-seven has two digits, four and seven.

cards.back: The value of a digit depends on its place in the number. In 47 the 4 means 4 tens.
cards.say: Place value. The value of a digit depends on its place in the number. In forty-seven the four means four tens.

cards.front: What is each digit worth in 47?
cards.say: What is each digit worth in forty-seven? Forty, which is four tens, and seven, which is seven ones. Forty plus seven equals forty-seven.

cards.front: What is each digit worth in 63?
cards.say: What is each digit worth in sixty-three? Sixty, which is six tens, and three, which is three ones. Sixty plus three equals sixty-three.

cards.front: What is each digit worth in 82?
cards.say: What is each digit worth in eighty-two? Eighty, which is eight tens, and two, which is two ones. Eighty plus two equals eighty-two.

cards.front: What is each digit worth in 95?
cards.say: What is each digit worth in ninety-five? Ninety, which is nine tens, and five, which is five ones. Ninety plus five equals ninety-five.

cards.front: What is each digit worth in 38?
cards.say: What is each digit worth in thirty-eight? Thirty, which is three tens, and eight, which is eight ones. Thirty plus eight equals thirty-eight.

cards.front: What is each digit worth in 56?
cards.say: What is each digit worth in fifty-six? Fifty, which is five tens, and six, which is six ones. Fifty plus six equals fifty-six.
Partition seventy-four. Seventy plus four. That is seven tens and four ones.

figure.alt: Seven tens rods and four ones cubes make seventy-four.

cards.say: Partition twenty-nine. Twenty plus nine. That is two tens and nine ones.

figure.alt: Two tens rods and nine ones cubes make twenty-nine.

cards.say: How many tens are in fifty? Five tens.

cards.front: How many ones are in 3 tens and 5 ones?
cards.say: How many ones are in three tens and five ones? Thirty-five ones. Thirty plus five equals thirty-five.
Two tens and six ones make twenty-six.
Nine tens and nine ones make ninety-nine. It is one less than one hundred.

cards.back: 10 tens make 1 hundred. 100 has three digits.
cards.say: Hundred. Ten tens make one hundred. One hundred has three digits.

figure.alt: One hundreds flat, which is ten tens.

cards.say: One more than thirty-nine is forty.
One less than sixty is fifty-nine.

cards.back: 55. The tens digit goes up by 1.
cards.say: Ten more than forty-five is fifty-five. The tens digit goes up by one.
Ten less than seventy-two is sixty-two.

cards.back: 64. It has more tens (6 tens is more than 4 tens).
cards.say: Which is bigger, forty-six or sixty-four? Sixty-four. It has more tens. Six tens is more than four tens.
Which is smaller, eighty-three or thirty-eight? Thirty-eight. It has fewer tens.
Put in order, smallest first: fifty-two, twenty-five, forty-five. Twenty-five, forty-five, fifty-two.
Write forty-eight in figures. Forty-eight is written four eight.
Write seventy-six in words. Seventy-six.
One hundred in words is one hundred.

cards.back: 50, because it is in the tens place.
cards.say: The five in fifty-eight is worth fifty, because it is in the tens place.
